raw.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use

dispositions.basis: Standalone JUnit owns finite daemon workers. Future/latch waits5s, finally shutdownNow/await10s, class30s; release before join. Unknown/nonterminal workers fail assertions. No webapp scheduling or product runtime authority.

raw.message: Avoid catching RuntimeException in try-catch block

dispositions.basis: Exactly two unchanged callback/clock boundaries mark the next observation discontinuous and rethrow the identical RuntimeException/Error. No swallow/translation/normal success/NPE handling. Whole ordinary tests and LOCK401/402 cover failure and the next gap.
